title: Add break-glass override flow for offline bundle verification (explicit flag + audit logging)
creator: Ethan Park
project: On-prem offline artifact signing (Private Deployment Automation)
description:
Goal
Implement an explicit, hard-to-misuse break-glass override for Redwood Private offline bundle verification. Default behavior must remain fail-closed. If a customer chooses to proceed without signature validity, the installer must:
- require an explicit override flag and acknowledgement
- emit an auditable local log entry (structured) capturing who/what/when/why
- guide the user toward the supported remediation path (re-transfer bundle, re-verify media, contact support)

Context
Air-gapped customers occasionally hit verification failures due to media transfer corruption, wrong bundle version, or missing signature files. We need an emergency escape hatch for regulated environments while keeping safe defaults and strong auditability.

Scope
1) CLI/UX
- Add an explicit break-glass flag to the installer verification / install path.
- Require a second explicit acknowledgement value (non-empty) so this can’t be enabled accidentally via copy/paste.
- Require a human-entered reason string to force operator intent and improve auditability.
- Ensure output clearly states what integrity guarantees are being bypassed and what is still being verified.

2) Behavior
- Default: verification failure blocks install (exit non-zero).
- With break-glass enabled: allow proceeding only by bypassing *signature validity* checks.
- IMPORTANT: continue to enforce manifest checksum validation for bundle contents (do not allow bypassing checksum mismatches in v1). If checksum mismatch occurs, still fail closed.
- Ensure break-glass applies only to the specific invocation (no persisted config that keeps it enabled).

3) Logging / audit trail (offline)
- Emit a structured local audit event when break-glass is requested (and when it is actually used).
- Audit event must include: installer version, timestamp (UTC), hostname, OS/user (best-effort; do not block if unavailable), bundle identifier (bundle version + manifest digest), signature file presence/paths, verification failure reason summary, operator-provided reason, and a clear field like override_used=true.
- Do not log secrets or full command-lines; sanitize flags and redact any path segments that look like tokens/credentials.

4) Docs/Runbooks
- Update customer-facing docs and internal runbooks to describe:
  - when break-glass is allowed vs not allowed
  - the exact flags/ack strings required
  - what evidence/logs to capture for support
  - follow-up steps (re-transfer bundle, verify checksums on media, confirm correct bundle for target version)

Non-goals
- Customer-managed keys / customer signing in v1.
- A general “skip all integrity checks” mode.

Proposed CLI (final naming can change during implementation)
- `--break-glass-allow-unsigned`
- `--break-glass-ack "I UNDERSTAND THIS BYPASSES SIGNATURE VERIFICATION"`
- `--break-glass-reason "<freeform text>"`

Acceptance criteria
- Installer refuses to proceed on signature validation failure by default.
- With break-glass flags, signature validation failures do not block, but manifest checksum mismatches still block.
- Break-glass path prints explicit warnings and includes the provided reason in the audit output.
- Two audit events are emitted:
  1) break_glass_requested (when flags are parsed/validated)
  2) break_glass_used (when verification fails and install proceeds anyway)
- Security review completed and recorded in the PR.
- Docs updates are created/tracked (can be a separate docs ticket, but this ticket must include the required text and links).

Notes / open questions
- Confirm whether we should require TTY for acknowledgement (prompt) vs allowing a non-interactive ack string for automation. Preference: allow non-interactive for enterprise automation, but require both ack + reason.
- Confirm log destination(s): local file next to installer logs + optional JSON line to stdout for log collection.

Implementation owner
- Benji Okafor (installer)
Reviewers
- Marcus Lin (security), Kevin Osei (audit/logging), Ethan Park (control plane/installer)
comments: 2025-02-14 — Ethan Park: Creating this as a follow-on to ENG-3914. We need a break-glass flow that satisfies Sec’s requirement: explicit operator intent + audit trail. Please keep it tightly scoped: bypass signature only, not checksums.

2025-02-16 — Marcus Lin: Security requirements: (1) fail-closed default, (2) two-step explicit override (flag + ack), (3) operator reason required, (4) structured audit record must be generated locally (offline), (5) no “skip all verification” in v1.

2025-02-18 — Kevin Osei: Logging: make sure we distinguish request vs actual use. Include bundle manifest sha256, installer version, and a stable event name for downstream export (customers will parse JSON). Avoid logging full argv; we’ve been burned by leaking paths w/ embedded creds.

2025-02-20 — Benji Okafor: Implementing as `--break-glass-allow-unsigned` + `--break-glass-ack` + `--break-glass-reason`. Will gate on non-empty reason and exact ack match. For automation, we’ll allow non-interactive usage (no TTY) as long as ack+reason are provided.
2025-02-24 — Benji Okafor: PR up with initial implementation + unit tests for ack validation and event emission. Still need to confirm exact JSON fields with Kevin and get Marcus sign-off on wording.

2025-02-26 — Marcus Lin: Reviewed PR. Requested changes: warning text must explicitly say “signature verification bypassed; checksum verification still enforced”, and require ack string to be exact-match (case sensitive) to prevent partial matches. Also requested a short pointer to the policy doc in the CLI output.

2025-02-28 — Benji Okafor: Addressed security review feedback. Added separate break_glass_requested and break_glass_used events, plus updated warning copy and exact-match ack requirement. Added redaction for argv logging and ensured we don’t echo the ack back in logs.

2025-03-03 — Ethan Park: Merged once CI green and security sign-off recorded. Follow-up: ensure docs ticket references the exact flags and includes screenshots/output snippets. Linking to ENG-3918 for docs work.

2025-03-06 — Benji Okafor: Closed. Verified locally in simulated air-gapped test: signature failure + break-glass proceeds; checksum mismatch still fails. Audit JSON emitted to installer log directory and to stdout when `--log-format json` is set.
